text.description_html:
BOM-LB8006-450N-630, Extra Heavy Lube Bearing NRP Hinge, Satin Stainless Steel

The 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" stainless steel hinge uses a special nylon bearing material that is maintenance free and requires little to no oil or grease. The special nylon bearings eliminate the use of any steel parts that could easily rust. The .180" thickness of the Bommer LB80006-450N-630 grants it strength for extra heavy duty jobs. The 4.5 x 4.5 x .180 Lube Bearing Hinge with Non-Removable Pin is made out of Stainless Steel with a brushed (satin) finish.

Package includes one (1) complete hinge with matching finish stainless steel flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Security Non-Removable Pin (NRP) for exterior outswing doors, prevents the hinge pins removal by vandals and thieves.

Also available: Bommer 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Stainless Steel Hinge with Lube Bearing and Non-Removable Pin with a 0.134" thickness.

Fitted with a high grade, Non-Removable, rust resistant, stainless steel flush tip hinge pin. Medium duty door hinge, standard .180" thickness. Standard full mortise hinge with 3 knuckle design.

Specifications for the Bommer LB8006-450N-630 Extra Heavy Duty 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" x .180" Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel, Non-Removable
  • Bearing: Nylon Bearings
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Thickness: .180"
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Removable Pin for Security
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A5112 for Bearing Hinges
  • Wood Screws: 4 ea. #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: 8 ea. #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Bommer LB8006-450N Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with stainless steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
